path.description: Exact originating path of the best substantive Shareholders' Agreement candidate, or null when none can be identified.

document_match.description: How strongly the selected document substantively matches a Shareholders' Agreement. Use None only with a null path.

concerns.description: Material caveats about document selection, such as missing or ambiguous agreement dates, signatures, execution pages, completeness, amendments, or current-version status.

paths_for_alternative_candidates.description: Exact originating paths of plausible alternative candidates, ordered from most to least likely.

selection_reason.description: Concise explanation of the substantive match and why this candidate was preferred over alternatives.
